post.caption: One diamond, then 529. The Packers won the first Super Bowl in 1967, and their ring held a single diamond in 10 karat gold. Jostens of Minneapolis made it, and Coach Vince Lombardi led its design. It was worth under 1,000 dollars. In 2017, the Patriots' ring had 283 diamonds for a 28 to 3 comeback. The Chiefs' 2024 ring has 529 diamonds and 38 rubies, with a hidden hinge that opens to the winning play. A half dollar coin fits through William Perry's size 25 ring.
